column1: # Per-section-pair acquisition design. Read by phenocycler/integration/modes.py.
# This file lists EXCEPTIONS only. A pair absent from it falls back to [integration] mode in
# config.ini (normally 'sequential'). That default is deliberate and fail-safe: analysing a
# same-slide pair sequentially is weaker than it needs to be
# as same_slide fabricates a cell-to-cell measurement. An omission costs resolution
# KEY = donor_id + roi + xenium_serial. The serial is part of the key because one donor+roi
# can hold BOTH designs: 6533/panc is a SERIAL pair on Xenium 0041393 and a SAME-SLIDE pair
# on 0080870. A blank xenium_serial is a wildcard covering every section of that donor+roi
# and is what applies when a caller does not say which section it means.
# mode = same_slide means ONE PHYSICAL SECTION WAS IMAGED TWICE. It is an acquisition fact
# so 'evidence' is required and must say what establishes it. --mode cannot assert it.
# Fail-safe wildcard: anything for 6533/panc that does not name a serial is the serial pair.
